title: Exact finite quotient realization for the concrete completed coefficient functor
statement: Take E to be koszulConstantFunctor T A followed by completedAdicScalarExtension T d, for an adic coefficient datum d and a finite generating list a for d.ideal. This concrete E is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. Its regular module is isomorphic, via c, to degree zero of the cochain tensor unit U. For every n, E applied to the extended degree-zero complex of the quotient of ULift A by the (n+1)st power of the span of the lifted a_i is isomorphic to level n of the actual ordinary quotient tower applied to U. Under this isomorphism c followed by E of the quotient projection and the inverse extension degree-zero identification is the degree-zero component of completedQuotientTensorUnit. No exterior complex, cone or augmentation is involved.

proof.text: Constant module sheafification is additive and exact. Compare the completed ring and scalar map to CompletedConstantReduction using finite coefficient identification and uniqueness of completedAdicScalar. Flatness makes extension of scalars exact, hence E additive and exact.

The regular module comparison is inverse multiplication. Use ULift.ringEquiv and ha to identify the lifted ideal quotient, then the normalized finite reduction isomorphism. Extend the single-complex comparison and compose with the inverse tensor unitor. On local pure tensors this is projection times the recorded constant quotient section, so the image of 1 proves the displayed normalization. This also covers all degenerate cases.

theorem completedKoszulFiniteQuotientRealization
    (T : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal) :
    let E := koszulConstantFunctor T A ⋙ completedAdicScalarExtension T d
    let U := 𝟙_ (CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ)
    ∃ (_hadd : E.Additive) (_hlim : PreservesFiniteLimits E)
      (_hcolim : PreservesFiniteColimits E)
      (c : U.X 0 ≅ E.obj (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} A) (ULift.{t + 1} A)))
      (eQ : ∀ n : ℕ, (E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} A))).obj
          (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} A)
            ((ULift.{t + 1} A) ⧸
              (Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ (ULift.up (a i) : ULift.{t + 1} A)))) ^
                (n + 1)))).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat) ≅
        (((completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj U).asFunctor.obj
          (op n)),
      ∀ n : ℕ, c.hom ≫ E.map (ModuleCat.ofHom
        ((Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ (ULift.up (a i) : ULift.{t + 1} A)))) ^
          (n + 1)).mkQ) ≫
        E.map ((((ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} A))).obj
          (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} A)
            ((ULift.{t + 1} A) ⧸
              (Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ (ULift.up (a i) : ULift.{t + 1} A)))) ^
                (n + 1)))).extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := 0) rfl).inv) ≫
        (eQ n).hom.f 0 = (completedQuotientTensorUnit T d U n).f 0
